WITH store_sales_agg AS (
    SELECT ss_quantity,
           COUNT(*) OVER () as total_count,
           AVG(ss_ext_tax) OVER () as ext_tax_avg,
           AVG(ss_net_paid_inc_tax) OVER () as net_paid_inc_tax_avg
    FROM store_sales
), bucket AS (
    SELECT CASE 
               WHEN total_count > 1071 THEN ext_tax_avg 
               ELSE net_paid_inc_tax_avg 
           END as avg_value,
           ss_quantity BETWEEN 1 AND 20 as bucket1,
           ss_quantity BETWEEN 21 AND 40 as bucket2,
           ss_quantity BETWEEN 41 AND 60 as bucket3,
           ss_quantity BETWEEN 61 AND 80 as bucket4,
           ss_quantity BETWEEN 81 AND 100 as bucket5
    FROM store_sales_agg
)
SELECT CASE WHEN bucket1 THEN avg_value END as bucket1,
       CASE WHEN bucket2 THEN avg_value END as bucket2,
       CASE WHEN bucket3 THEN avg_value END as bucket3,
       CASE WHEN bucket4 THEN avg_value END as bucket4,
       CASE WHEN bucket5 THEN avg_value END as bucket5
FROM bucket, reason 
WHERE r_reason_sk = 1
